notes:
Snapshot: mid-market e-commerce platform (direct-to-consumer + marketplace sellers). Catalog ~12M SKUs (flattened variants count). Current infra: Solr + Algolia for facets, homegrown ANN; experimenting with embeddings + transformer reranker. Primary goal: reduce false positives in long-tail search + improve AOV via reranking while holding cost per query near <$0.002 (current prototyping costs ~ $0.012-0.018/q using naive reranker).

Key constraints / asks:
- Indexing scale: full embedding index ~12M vectors, daily full embed reindex unlikely; need incremental/delta embedding pipeline for 500K daily catalog updates (price, stock, images).
- Latency: search p95 end-to-end target <= 200ms; additional neural reranker p95 budget <= 60ms.
- Throughput & spikes: baseline QPS 120-200, seasonal spikes 10x+ (Black Friday/Cyber Monday) — want graceful degradation and predictable unit cost.
- Cost sensitivity: target blended cost/query (ANN + rerank + model tokens) < $0.0015-0.002. Priorities: batching, quantized models for rerank, top-K hybrid rerank (ANN top-50 -> rerank top-10).
- Security: require SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, audit logs, KMS integration for key material, EU data residency for EU-sourced sellers.

What they tried so far:
- BM25 + heuristics gave decent baseline speed but poor semantic recall for long-tail queries.
- Off-the-shelf Algolia for faceted experience but limited semantic match.
- Prototype: embeddings in local ANN + a 13B reranker (unquantized) — showed ~20% CTR lift but cost blowout in peak.

What they want from Redwood:
- Recommendation: compact reranker (quantized 8-bit/4-bit) + hosted ANN with prefix/KV caching to meet latency SLOs.
- Smart routing to cheaper regions during non-peak and automatic fallback to smaller model variants when under capacity pressure.
- Optimize suggestions: batching windows for steady traffic and aggressive KV caching for popular SKUs during promotions.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency and trace events for rerank step, regression alerts tied to golden query sets.

Quotes from stakeholders:
- "We need predictable economics for Black Friday — last year the model cost doubled our infra budget." — Head of Engineering
- "Must show per-query cost under simulated 10x traffic or we can't go forward." — VP Product

POC Plan (high level):
- Phase 0: data handoff + schema (embedding fields, product metadata) — week 0
- Phase 1: baseline run (hosted small embeddings + 7B reranker quantized) — weeks 1-2
- Phase 2: Black Friday spike simulation (10x QPS) and cost modeling (dedicated pool vs hosted mix) — week 3
- Phase 3: integrate incremental embedding update pipeline (delta compute) and measure convergence — week 4

Measurement targets for POC:
- Recall@10 >= baseline + 12%
- End-to-end p95 <= 200ms at baseline, <= 300ms under 10x spike with graceful fallback
- Blended cost/query <= $0.002 at projected 2026 peak volumes

Open technical questions:
- Feasibility of incremental embedding compute under vendor-managed hosted API vs Dedicated (delta CPU/GPU cost tradeoffs).
- Effective ANN topology (HNSW vs IVF+PQ) at 12M vectors for sub-50ms ANN recall.
- Warm-up strategies for KV/prefix caches to avoid cold-start latency in sudden promotions.
